column5: mode 12 is a 16-bit float in MRC2014; Bio-Formats returns the bytes as int8 (twice the width); spec-derived truth is the reference
MRC2014 (version 20140) defines mode 0 as signed int8; Bio-Formats reports uint8 (same bytes)
mode 101 (IMOD 4-bit samples) is returned as int8 bytes by Bio-Formats; scopeio unpacks the nibbles
bioformats-rs rejects mode 101 (payload shorter than declared)
space group 401 marks a stack of nz / mz volumes; Bio-Formats reports nz sections as Z (same planes, same order); scopeio reports Z = mz, T = nz / mz
